description: Useful localization tools with Python API for building localization & translation systems

latest_release.body:
*Released on 26 November 2026*

This release adds support for named plural forms, expands HTML attribute
translation, and adds browser extension message support to `json2po`.

## Changes

### Formats and Converters

- Plural forms
  - Add named plural support for Android and i18next v4 so edits and
    merges can match translations by category across locales with
    different plural rules.
  - Preserve explicit categories and sparse plural forms when editing
    Apple Stringsdict and XLIFF, Go-i18n JSON and TOML, Go text
    selectors, GWT properties, and Ruby YAML.
- HTML
  - Extract and write back human-readable HTML and ARIA attributes while
    preserving ID references.
  - Use `data-translate-attribute` to mark custom attributes for
    translation.
- JSON and YAML
  - Convert browser extension messages and their descriptions to PO with
    the `webextension` personality in `json2po`.
  - Skip numbers and booleans during JSON extraction.
  - Skip floating-point numbers and dates during YAML extraction and
    preserve them from the template when converting back to YAML.
- Markdown and MDX
  - Switch to markdown-it-py and preserve soft line breaks next to
    inline HTML and closing markers on empty ATX headings.
- Escape PHP translation values during serialization and limit the work
  done when parsing incomplete Windows resource files.

### Other

- Sort multiple `poterminology` translations by frequency.
- Keep signed phone numbers together during sentence segmentation.
- Speed up brace placeholder checks, number scanning, Java properties
  parsing, Trados reads, and Gettext MO serialization.
- Update dependencies and separate package validation from publishing in
  CI.

## Contributors

This release was made possible by the following contributors:

Michal Čihař, Dixing Xu, Prince Nzamuwe, Jay Hemnani, Kristofers
Jurevics, Aiden
